summary: This room was five walks, and the same shape showed up in three of them: an entry that already reaches OUT toward the target, sitting right next to a body paragraph that names the target by name — but nobody wired the return trip. ELDER, Return Ceremony, and SCHEMA — Reference are all under-reached not because the palace lacks relevant neighbors but because the citation stopped at prose. Substrate Skill tells its reader to "read [[ELDER]], then [[SCHEMA]]" and links neither. Deposit Ceremony sends a drafter to "SCHEMA.md and SCHEMA — Reference.md on disk" and links only the first. Concierge says outright it was "built... for the Return Ceremony, which summons this companion as its first act" and carries no link back. Those three are the cleanest finds in the room — no inference needed, just an already-written sentence with an un-typed name in it. No Mind Checks Itself and Reflective Practice needed a different kind of walk: both are well-linked outward already, so the find was in their neighbors' bodies quoting them back (Reflective Practice's own "same shape as Drift and Consolidation," "The Palace Practices on Itself § insularity") without the neighbor closing the loop. One genuine snag: No Mind Checks Itself → exemplifies → Bring In a Bigger Mind reads backwards against the schema's own direction invariant (exemplifies should point from specific to its general ground, not the reverse) — flagged, not fixed. Two of the five targets (No Mind Checks Itself, Return Ceremony) read as more developed than their `seed` stage suggests — both carry substantial, cited, multi-section bodies that outgrew the stage label some time ago.

typed_relations.label: the-unverifiable-check

typed_relations.evidence: "[[Closing Well]]'s hardest discipline is naming, in the punchlist, exactly what you could not verify from inside your own pass" — No Mind Checks Itself.md:51

typed_relations.label: differently-textured-voice
typed_relations.rationale: Dialectic is the palace's own mechanism for bringing a differently-textured mind into contact with a claim — the exact structural move No Mind Checks Itself argues is load-bearing everywhere. Neither currently names the other.

typed_relations.label: the-practice-this-grounds
typed_relations.rationale: Per SCHEMA §4's direction invariant, exemplifies must point BACK from the specific instance to its general ground. Here the general principle (No Mind Checks Itself) points forward to the specific practice (Bring In a Bigger Mind) it grounds — backwards. Either flip it (Bring In a Bigger Mind → exemplifies → No Mind Checks Itself) or retype the existing direction to something forward-legal (enables/spawned).
typed_relations.evidence: No Mind Checks Itself.md:11-13, label "the-practice-this-grounds" names the ground relationship but the type points the wrong way for it.

Three genuine inbound proposals plus one retype flag on its own outbound link to Bring In a Bigger Mind (direction runs backwards against the schema's exemplifies convention). Stage looks under-set.
